title: Keys from LP1-08’s hidden grid
question: Do the fixed, repeated keys derived from the solved P08 hint grid pass the source's frequency screen on LP2 pages?
reader_question: Can the earlier hint grid serve as a repeating key for Liber Primus?
summary: The source's grid matches the saved LP1-08 OutGuess payload. Its old page range includes nine solved LP1 pages, where 99 of 103 phase-sweep threshold hits occur. Four hits on LP2-32 reduce to two frequency relations and no independently checked reading.
finding: Across 17,766 source-specified rotated-key cases, 99 of 103 IoC>1.25 hits are on solved LP1 pages. The four LP2 hits are all on LP2-32; three are algebraically related. A retrospective LP2-only shared-shuffle diagnostic has 0/199 maxima at the observed 1.382, but does not identify a reading or cipher.
limitations: This is a corrected-path adaptation: the source script points at nonexistent tools/pages. The original old P08–54 range covers LP1-08–16 and LP2-00–37 only. The source screen tests rune frequency, not readable text. The LP2-only comparison was selected after inspecting the LP1/LP2 split; conditional shuffles and 199 trials do not account for the wider historical choice of clue interpretations and key families.
next_steps: Require a fixed full-page decoding rule with preserved word structure and a held-out prediction before treating a grid-derived key as a reading.

scope.representation: Exact committed Wulfic page_08–54 rune files, mapped to current LP1-08–16 and LP2-00–37; 14/28-value keys from source-embedded hint pairs independently matched to the saved LP1-08 OutGuess bytes.
scope.procedure: Verify source-grid rows against the 140-byte LP1-08 payload; correct the legacy page path, replay seven unrotated keys and five keys at all rotations in three GP29 modes using the source IoC/singleton gates; encrypt known LP1 readings as positive controls; shuffle each source page 199 times and repeat the whole phase sweep.
scope.parameters: 47 pages; 987 fixed and 17,766 rotated-key cases; 510 planted transforms; source fixed IoC>1.3 or IoC>1.15 with singletons I/A, rotated IoC>1.25; 199 shared page shuffles. A later LP2-only readout uses the same random stream.
scope.exclusions: Other grid interpretations, bigram substitution, Koan-text keys, later LP2 pages, non-GP29 encodings, alternative word scoring and any broader historical idea search.

review.kind: pinned public-source corrected-path adaptation with independently verified carrier bytes, observed cases and planted controls
review.reviewer: LP1-08 extracted rows match the source literal exactly; all 47 raw page arrays, source-row key arithmetic, 18,753 observed scores and 510 planted recoveries independently checked; complete seeded null recomputes in run.py and diagnostic.py

reproduction.environment: Python 3 with NumPy; source page bytes and the archived 140-byte LP1-08 extraction are bundled, so the external sparse Git checkout is not required to rerun the adaptation.
